about: The explorer's notes on the shrine town (carts/garden/shrinetown/DESIGN.md): its sealed places and their intended ways in, its shortcuts' two ends, and the glide cases to measure.

sealed.name: star 4's chamber (inside the sacred cedar)
sealed.why: DESIGN 5, star 4: hang along the cedar rope to the knot hole's sill (21.5), then down the shaft to the chamber (13.1); the rope is hang only. The region is the chamber and its shaft (r 2.2) and the sill (r 3.6). The root door (shortcut D) opens from inside.
